fields.why: The Results and Figure set the share of practices offering immunization to each of 5 child age groups side by side (<12 months, 1-2 years ... 11-18 years), an outcome per SPD group; defensible though the age groups are service categories, not partitions of the practices.
Urban/rural is the county of the practice (non-human units) and Census region is geography, so neither is an SPD; age is the only groupwise dimension.
No test is run across the age groups; the chi-square tests are urban vs rural and each region vs Northeast, so the mechanical flag is a false alarm.
